Question
========
JSON is one of the most common formats for exchanging semi-structured data on the web. What does the abbreviation "JSON" stand for?


Solution
========
JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation. Despite the name, it is not tied to the JavaScript language - it is a lightweight, text-based format that many programming languages, including R, can read and write.
